Sample.evidence_source: Our purposive sampling procedure allowed us to include a wide sample of experiences among young men and women, with both single and multiple suicidal acts, of different durations of time since the act, and initially treated at 3 different hospitals.

Country.evidence_source: Nonetheless, our findings can be generalized only to young Italian adults, and attitudes may differ in other countries or even in other regions of Italy.
